subject: txn: do not create hook closure if it is already set (#53764)
summary: Reviewed first-parent diff for kv/session. Change adds `kv.Transaction.MemHookSet()` and delegates it via `session.LazyTxn`, then uses it in `session.(*session).SetMemoryFootprintChangeHook()` to early-return and avoid repeatedly allocating/storing the same mem-footprint hook closure on repeated `Txn(true)` calls. Dependency bump to `github.com/tikv/client-go/v2@...ac8fa1d73a0c` provides `KVTxn.MemHookSet()`/`MemDB.MemHookSet()` so the new interface method is well-defined. No plausible Blocker/High issues found in transaction/session correctness, concurrency, or memory-tracking semantics. Later history up to `upstream/master` shows no follow-up change specifically correcting this hook-set check (only an unrelated rollback safety change in `pkg/session/txn.go`).
